---
title: Manage Banner Image
description: >-
  Review your active banner sliders, edit or delete visual banners to keep your
  loyalty application's interface up to date.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="892" height="493" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Banner > Banner List.&#x20;

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="323" height="191" />

2. Click to view banner details, delete or duplicate banner.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="746" height="306" />

3.

- Modify existing banner image and details.

* Delete or duplicate banner.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="399" height="315" />
